item.title: Ada Hayden Heritage Park Lake a trout opportunity in Iowa’s Story County
item.description: Iowa’s Ada Hayden Heritage Park Lake is a 137-acre body of water that offers anglers a chance to catch trout throughout the year in Story County. The DNR notes in its latest fishing report that trout were stocked on Jan. 30. At that time, ice thickness was 12 inches. item.title: Iowa DNR sets public meetings to recap hunting, trapping seasons, discuss possible rule changes
item.description: The Iowa Department of Natural Resources (DNR) is hosting a series of town hall-style meetings where local staff will provide updates on recently completed hunting and trapping seasons, discuss possible changes to hunting and trapping rules and regulations, and address other topics as requested. “We want people to come out to these meetings, listen to the seasons reviews, ask questions and hear directly from our staff,” said Todd Bishop, chief of the Iowa DNR’s Wildlife Bureau. item.title: Will hook-and-bullet issues get lost during Minnesota’s 2026 legislative session?
